subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'BANYAN' is written as 'EDQBDQ' and 'LAUNCH' is written as 'ODXQFK'. How will 'STRIKER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BANYAN' is written as 'EDQBDQ',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/242b8a16aba4f4c39556487aa53a9528c4ffd25f0ccb308cb7193a953de979c2.png] 

‘LAUNCH' is written as 'ODXQFK’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddb903163e53678777e19d63cdd72fa01459c65c6f3533e4ebf3b2566f28b75c.png] 

Similarly, for '**STRIKER**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566674d1d201830174e1f0fb0a9b20e8149956e5aa50f2c6b8b02ce4165c6884.png] 

So, '**STRIKER**' will be written as '**VWULNHU**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
